inputs.sequence_prompt:
A single uninterrupted fifteen-second live-action shot starting exactly from the supplied frame. This camera is on the INSIDE of the airship, looking toward the boarding opening and the theatre beyond it. The foreground wooden floor is the ship's safe interior deck. The grey wooden gangway behind the gate leads OUT toward the stone theatre. Keep the camera absolutely fixed, the three real actors and all scenery unchanged. The ship stays docked.
Locke is the brown-haired man with blue bandana on the left. His shield remains in his LEFT hand and his sword remains sheathed. Celes stands at center in the ivory gown and blue sash. Setzer is the silver-haired man on the existing stairs at right, facing them. The existing X-braced wooden gate is open inward, parked in the left foreground. Its hinge remains at the original left post. Its free edge must swing AWAY from this camera, back toward the boarding opening, to close. Closing must leave ALL THREE people on this camera's side of the gate.
In the first two seconds Setzer looks at Locke and gives one calm instruction in Brazilian Portuguese, with a mature male voice and synchronized mouth: <d>[Portuguese] Feche o portão, Locke.</d> Both listeners keep their mouths closed. Locke looks at the panel, then takes one deliberate step FORWARD TOWARD THE CAMERA onto the foreground ship planks, away from the theatre. He pivots on these planted boots to face the gate, with his back partly toward the camera. Celes stays clear beside the cabin. Locke never steps onto the grey gangway.
During the middle of the shot Locke grips the free end of the gate's top rail with his empty RIGHT hand. From his position in the foreground INSIDE THE SHIP he PUSHES the panel away from his own body and away from the camera, back toward the boarding opening. The rigid panel rotates smoothly around its unchanged original left hinges. He follows it only with his right arm and a small side step along the foreground deck. His torso, shield and BOTH boots always remain in front of the panel on the camera side, visible between the gate and the camera; the wooden panel never hides his legs. Celes watches the edge approach the opposite post. The gate reaches the existing post, separating the EMPTY grey gangway behind it from all three people on the ship. Same X braces, same dimensions, same hinges and fixed railing throughout.
Locke keeps his boots on the foreground deck, secures the latch from the INSIDE with his right hand and pulls the closed top rail once toward himself to check that it stays shut. After checking, he releases the rail and takes one clear step diagonally RIGHT toward Celes, still on the same foreground ship deck. End with Locke and Celes together on the camera side, with the closed gate visibly BEHIND Locke and the empty gangway farther behind the panel. Locke looks up and nods once toward Setzer. Setzer acknowledges on the stair tread, turns and takes the next supported step upward on the existing staircase. Natural breathing and cloth movement keep the ending alive.
Sound is exactly the one Portuguese sentence above followed by low evening wind, cloth and shield strap rustle, separate boot contacts, hinge creak and the latch click at the visible contact. No extra words, narration or song. Real-time continuous movement, rigid scenery, steady warm lantern, unchanged cast. No camera change or edit. Nobody exits the ship, steps onto the gangway, crosses a closed gate or passes through wood. The ship and gangway remain stationary.
